request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: Developing and testing a clinical decision-support algorithm; we will only export model parameters and evaluation metrics.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised HbA1c values of patients with type 2 diabetes.
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient; patients without a HbA1c are left out.
Report per hospital: patients with type 2 diabetes who have a HbA1c value and their mean HbA1c, one decimal.
